confirm.description: The `token` of the preview of exactly this request. Needed when the preview lists effects; a missing or outdated token is answered with `confirmation_required` and the current preview.

source_sha256.description: The `source_sha256` of the preview that was looked at. When it is sent and the saved draft is another text, because somebody saved it again since, nothing is published and the answer is `409 confirmation_required` with the current preview. Leave it out to publish whichever draft is saved; a token (`confirm`) already binds the draft it was made for.

description: Publishes the draft. The body may be empty when the preview lists no effects; otherwise it carries the preview's token as `confirm`. Send `source_sha256` as well to be sure that the draft published is the one that was looked at.
